titulo: Your own domain vs a borrowed link
hooks: Is your website just a Linktree link?
Is your web address actually yours?
What your link says about you
voz: When you share a Linktree or Instagram link, your business lives in someone else's house. With your own domain, the address carries your name and it's yours: it goes on your business card, your truck and your email. If a social network changes tomorrow, your address stays the same.

visual.texto: Your business, in someone else's house

captions: A Linktree or Instagram link depends on another company's rules. Your own domain, like yourbusiness.com, is yours to control and sticks with you even when social media changes.
Your domain goes on your business card, your storefront, your truck and your email. It's your business's address on the internet, and it should belong to you.
What's easier to remember and spell out over the phone: yourbusiness.com or a link full of underscores and numbers?
